items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: Sugar Johnny was a nice trumpet player. He played with Roy Palmer.

ctx.x: Yeah, I never got to knowing that.

He was a good trumpet player. Yeah, I've heard about him. I played in the band with him too, drummer. I don't play in the band with Sugar Johnny. Sugar Johnny was a nice trumpet player. He played with Roy Palmer.
I knew Roy Palmer. Roy Palmer, I played with him too.
